subject.title: UI/TUI: session-recap block leaks into visible user message rendering

question: Should maintainers wait for https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/252 to be rebased, or replace/adopt it with a maintainer-owned narrow fix for the shared stripper?
rationale: The bug and fix boundary are clear, but the only open implementation candidate is outside the target repository, dirty, and not maintainer-modifiable.

options.title: Ask For Rebase
options.body: Keep the issue paired with the fork PR and ask the contributor to rebase it onto current main with maintainer-modifiable settings if possible.

options.title: Replace Or Adopt The Fix
options.body: Open or adopt a narrow target-repository replacement, credit the source work, and close the fork PR only after the replacement exists.

options.title: Wait Without Action
options.body: Leave both items open until the fork PR author updates it, accepting that the source-reproducible bug remains unresolved meanwhile.

recommendation.title: Replace Or Adopt The Fix
recommendation.body: Open or adopt a narrow target-repository replacement, credit the source work, and close the fork PR only after the replacement exists.

likelyOwner.reason: They are tied to both the original shared-stripper merge and the TUI leading-stripper path, making them the strongest routing candidate for this shared UI/TUI boundary choice.
